description:
NotoScribe records and transcribes your conversations —
meetings, lectures, calls, interviews — and turns them into
structured, searchable notes organised into spaces.

This connector lets you work with those recordings directly in
chat. Ask what was decided in a meeting you had last month, pull
the action items out of a call, compare what a client said across
several conversations, or find the one recording where a topic
came up.

It can list your spaces, browse the recordings inside them, read
any single note with its full transcript, and answer questions
across a whole space with citations back to the source
recordings.

Access is read-only. It cannot create, edit, or delete anything
in your account, and it only reaches spaces you can already open.
You sign in with your existing NotoScribe account and can
disconnect at any time.

defaultPrompt: What spaces do I have in NotoScribe?
List my spaces, then summarise my three most recent recordings with their decisions and action items.
